headline: China Tightens Oversight of Automaker Vendor Payments Amid Price War
summary: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology mandated the auto manufacturers association to assess payment cycles across 17 major carmakers to curb vendor payment delays amid domestic price wars.
why: Prolonged payment terms by automakers put severe cash-flow strain on component suppliers across China's multi-billion-dollar automotive supply chain.

impacts.name: China Automotive
impacts.why: Stricter payment compliance could force carmakers to release trapped working capital to suppliers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
